'''Jonas Escalus''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] of the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Old Sith Empire]]. He was the last retainer of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Aloysius Kallig]], who entrusted him with the possession of his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] to keep on safe until [[Darth Nox|Kallig's heir]] arrived to reclaim it.
